items.name: lino_codec_handles_special_chars
items.source:
#[test]
fn lino_codec_handles_special_chars() {
    let rec = TokenRecord {
        github_repos: Vec::new(),
        id: "id1".into(),
        label: "with \"quote\" and \\ backslash and\nnewline".into(),
        issued_at: 1,
        expires_at: 2,
        revoked: true,
        sliding_window_seconds: None,
        account: None,
        max_requests: Some(100),
        used_requests: 7,
        max_tokens: Some(1_000),
        used_tokens: 250,
        reserved_tokens: 0,
        rate_limit_per_minute: Some(10),
        rate_window_started_at: 1_700_000_000,
        rate_window_requests: 2,
        scope: crate::token::ADMIN_SCOPE.to_string(),
        client_kind: Some("claude".into()),
        principal_id: Some("primary".into()),
        ephemeral: false,
        run_lease_expires_at: None,
        model_policy: crate::model_contract::ModelAccessPolicy::default(),
    };
    let s = associative::encode_text(std::iter::once(&rec));
    let parsed = associative::decode_text(&s).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(parsed.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(parsed[0], rec);
}
